evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts.
